# Pints, Pounds, & Pâté

> > A travel blog helping Americans avoid tourist mistakes and pack smartly for Europe, with guides covering England, Scotland, France, Italy, Spain, and North America.

Pints, Pounds, & Pâté offers practical travel advice focused on European destinations (particularly England, Scotland, France, Italy, and Spain) plus select U.S. and Canadian locations. The site specializes in helping American tourists navigate cultural norms, avoid common mistakes, and pack appropriately for international travel.

## Key Topics

- Tourist mistakes in Europe
- Europe packing guides
- American tourists abroad
- England and Scotland travel
- France and Italy travel
- Spain travel tips
- Cultural norms in Europe
- What not to wear in Europe
- London and Edinburgh guides
- Paris day trips
- Continental Europe travel
- U.S. and Canada destinations
- Colonial Williamsburg
- Indianapolis dining and events
